tables.name: Law Enforcement
tables.description: Modified by Priority, Merchant Overflow and Leadership. Modifies Crime. Town policing is always sanctioned by a higher legal authority.

results.name: None
results.description: This could be good or bad, depending on one’s point of view. Good if the folk here are trustworthy, but bad if a situation gets out of hand. (-8 to crime roll)

results.name: Sheriff
results.description: A sheriff, as well as a handful of deputies, is sanctioned by the town’s governing entity. (-4 to crime roll)

results.name: Small Town Watch
results.description: The watch is run by a nominated captain, and employs a small number of guards. Presence may be scattered, or lacking, at times. (-2 to crime roll)

results.name: Town Watch
results.description: The watch is run by an appointed captain, with one lieutenant, and enough guards, to adequately guard key points in the town with token patrols. (+0 to crime roll)

results.name: Strong Town Watch
results.description: The watch is run by a seasoned captain with two lieutenants, a few corporals, and an ample quantity of boots on the ground. Presence allows for extra patrols and well-rested guards. (+4 to crime roll)

results.name: Extensive Town Watch
results.description: The watch is overseen by a decorated captain with three lieutenants, several corporals and more than enough guards. Presence allows for the watch to maintain an ever-present appearance. A guard is never more than a shout away. (+8 to crime roll)
